text: DeepSeek 峰谷提示是 DSH Web 插件，会在会话输入框工具栏注册一个徽章，仅在当前模型属于 DeepSeek provider 时显示。它按北京时间判断工作日高峰时段及中国法定节假日，展示当前按高峰价或空闲价计费，并在悬停或键盘聚焦时提供模型、下次切换时间、计费规则和节假日覆盖年份。无法解析当前模型时显示未知状态；非 DeepSeek provider 时隐藏。适合希望在发送请求前快速查看 DeepSeek 当前计费时段的 DSH 用户。无需额外 API key 或外部账号。

DeepSeek peak-hours badge adds a composer indicator for the selected DeepSeek model. It shows peak, off-peak, or unknown status using Beijing time and Chinese holidays. Hover or focus reveals the model, next switch time, and rule. Other providers are hidden. No extra key or account is needed.
想在 DSH 输入框里看 DeepSeek 现在是高峰价还是空闲价。
能不能在选模型时顺便提示 DeepSeek 计费时段和下次切换时间？
Show me whether my selected DeepSeek model is currently in peak billing hours.
DeepSeek 峰谷提示的功能「输入框徽章」：显示当前 DeepSeek 模型的高峰、空闲或未知计费状态；悬停或聚焦可查看模型、切换时间和规则，其他 provider 隐藏。

dsh-provider-peak README · DeepSeek 峰谷提示（dsh-provider-peak）：[](https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak/actions/workflows/test.yml)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 插件。在会话输入框工具栏常驻一枚小徽章，显示 DeepSeek API 当前按**高峰**还是**空闲**价计费；徽章跟随当前选中的模型，只有模型属于 DeepSeek 的 provider 时才出现。

- `● 空闲`（绿点）：空闲时段，价格为高峰价的 5 折
- `● 高峰`（黄点）：高峰时段，按标准价计费
- 悬停或键盘聚焦：徽章出现底色反馈，并弹出详情浮层（当前模型、距下次切换多久、切换时刻、计费规则、节假日数据覆盖年份）
- 选中 Xiaomi 等其他 provider：徽章自动隐藏
- 模型信息尚未解析或加载失败：灰色 `未知`
- 中英双语，跟随界面语言；零依赖、免构建，装上即用

dsh-provider-peak README · 插件页（推荐）：1. 打开 DSH Web。
2. 进入 **设置 → 插件**，在安装框粘贴仓库地址：

```text
   https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
   ```

3. 安装后刷新页面。

dsh-provider-peak README · 命令行：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
```

`desktop` 配置档由 Electron 独占，只能走界面。安装后刷新页面。

dsh-provider-peak README · 本地开发：```sh
git clone https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-provider-peak
```

目录安装是 `link:`，改完 `client.js` 刷新页面即可，不必重装。

dsh-provider-peak README · 峰谷规则：| 时段 | 北京时间 | 价格 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 高峰 | 周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日） | 标准价 |
| 空闲 | 其余全部时间，含周末与法定节假日全天 | 高峰价的 50% |

规则与价格以 [DeepSeek 官方价格页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing) 为准（核对于 2026-10-18）。

dsh-provider-peak README · 哪些 provider 会显示：| 选中的 provider | 徽章 |
| --- | --- |
| `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-account`（内置 DeepSeek） | `高峰` / `空闲` |
| 名称为 `DeepSeek` 的 provider（如 pi-ai 里配置、指向 api.deepseek.com 的 `deepseek` 路由） | `高峰` / `空闲` |
| 其他 provider（`xiaomi-token-plan-cn`、名称不是 DeepSeek 的第三方中转等） | 隐藏 |
| 模型信息尚未解析 / 加载失败 | `未知` |

判定逻辑在 `client.js` 的 `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_IDS` 与 `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_NAME`。

dsh-provider-peak README · 自定义：| 想改什么 | 位置 |
| --- | --- |
| provider 白名单 | `client.js` 的 `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_IDS` / `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_NAME` |
| 高峰窗口 | `client.js` 的 `PEAK_WINDOWS` |
| 节假日 | `client.js` 的 `HOLIDAY_RANGES` / `HOLIDAY_COVERAGE` |
| 文案 | `client.js` 的 `DICT`（zh / en）；插件卡标题在 `locale/*.json` |

修改后刷新页面（目录安装）或重新安装（GitHub 安装）。

| `client.js` | 全部浏览器端逻辑：槽位注册、locale 文案、选中模型读取、峰谷计算与徽章渲染 |

| `test/policy.test.mjs` | 峰谷与 provider 判定的单元测试 |

dsh-provider-peak README · 开发与测试：```sh
node --check client.js
npm test
```

测试使用 `node:test`，从 `client.js` 的 `// --- policy logic` 标记块中取出纯函数执行，不依赖浏览器。

dsh-provider-peak README · 兼容性：- 在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 上开发与验证。
- 使用 Harness 自带能力：`conversation.input.left` 槽位、`ctx.modelDirectories` 服务、`ctx.locale`、`--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token。
- 只引用主题 token，深浅色主题都跟随宿主；没有引用任何 Harness Client 包。
- DSH 若调整槽位名、模型目录服务或 locale API，需要跟着更新。

dsh-provider-peak README · DeepSeek peak-hours badge (dsh-provider-peak)：[](https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak/actions/workflows/test.yml)

*[中文](README.md) · English*

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web plugin. It renders a compact badge in the session composer toolbar showing whether the DeepSeek API is currently billed at **peak** or **off-peak** rates. The badge follows the model selected in the current Session and only appears when that model belongs to a DeepSeek provider.

dsh-provider-peak README · DeepSeek peak-hours badge (dsh-provider-peak)：- `● Off-peak` (green): off-peak hours, half of the peak rate
- `● Peak` (amber): peak hours, standard rate
- Hover or keyboard-focus the badge: it highlights and a tooltip opens with the current model, time until the next switch, the switch instant (Beijing time), the rule, and the holiday-data coverage
- Selecting another provider (e.g. Xiaomi) hides the badge
- An unresolved model selection renders a neutral `Unknown` chip
- Bilingual (Chinese / English), follows the UI locale; zero dependencies, no build step

dsh-provider-peak README · Plugin page (recommended)：1. Open DSH Web.
2. Go to **Settings → Plugins** and paste:

```text
   https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
   ```

3. Refresh the page after installation.

dsh-provider-peak README · CLI：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
```

The `desktop` profile is managed by Electron and only accepts the UI path. Refresh the page after installation.

dsh-provider-peak README · Local development：```sh
git clone https://github.com/moonmoonCL/dsh-provider-peak
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-provider-peak
```

A directory install is a `link:`: edit `client.js`, refresh the page, and no reinstall is needed.

dsh-provider-peak README · Billing rule：| Period | Beijing time | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Peak | Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding Chinese public holidays | standard |
| Off-peak | every other instant, including weekends and holidays in full | 50% of peak |

Source: [DeepSeek API Models & Pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) (checked 2026-10-18).

dsh-provider-peak README · Which providers show the badge：| Selected provider | Badge |
| --- | --- |
| `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-account` (bundled DeepSeek) | `Peak` / `Off-peak` |
| A provider named `DeepSeek` (e.g. a pi-ai route pointing at api.deepseek.com) | `Peak` / `Off-peak` |
| Any other provider (e.g. `xiaomi-token-plan-cn`, third-party gateways) | hidden |
| Model information unresolved / failed to load | `Unknown` |

The rule lives in `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_IDS` and `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_NAME` in `client.js`.

dsh-provider-peak README · Customize：| Change | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Provider allowlist | `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_IDS` / `DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER_NAME` in `client.js` |
| Peak windows | `PEAK_WINDOWS` in `client.js` |
| Holidays | `HOLIDAY_RANGES` / `HOLIDAY_COVERAGE` in `client.js` |
| Wording | `DICT` (zh / en) in `client.js`; plugin-card text in `locale/*.json` |

Refresh the page (directory install) or reinstall (GitHub install) after editing.

dsh-provider-peak README · Layout：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js` | All browser-side logic: slot registration, locale dictionaries, model lookup, schedule computation, badge rendering |
| `index.js` | Empty Host plugin (all rendering is client-side) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Plugin row inserted on install |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin-manager title and description |
| `test/policy.test.mjs` | Schedule and provider-classification tests |
| `docs/verification.md` | Verification record and limits |

dsh-provider-peak README · Develop and test：```sh
node --check client.js
npm test
```

Tests use `node:test` and extract the pure functions from the `// --- policy logic` block in `client.js`; no browser is needed.

dsh-provider-peak README · Compatibility：- Developed and verified on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`.
- Uses built-in Harness surfaces: the `conversation.input.left` slot, the `ctx.modelDirectories` service, `ctx.locale`, and `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens.
- Only theme tokens are referenced, so light and dark themes follow the host; no Harness Client package is imported.
- A changed slot name, model-directory service, or locale API in DSH requires a matching update here.

dsh-provider-peak README · Verification：See [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md). Unit tests, directory and GitHub installation, and the live slot registration were verified; visual appearance has not been captured as a screenshot in a browser-controlled environment.
